annotations.title: Assign my set to my class (teachers)

description: Signed-in teachers only. Side effect: makes one of the teacher's own flashcard sets homework for one of the teacher's own classes, and notifies that class's students in SpeakBase and by email, once. Without confirmed=true it changes nothing and returns what would happen (set, class, number of students, due date). It does not create, change or delete cards, and cannot touch other teachers' classes.

class.description: The class name or class_id, as listed by my_classes.

confirmed.description: true only when the teacher has said yes to assigning this set to this class and notifying its students.

due_in_days.description: Days until the homework is due. Default 7; 0 for no due date.

set_id.description: The set_id of one of the teacher's own sets (from create_set or my_sets), or its SpeakBase link.
